evidence.notes: InboundEmailHandler is a user Apex callback interface; local tests dispatch handleInboundEmail on the user implementation and return an InboundEmailResult DTO.

name: core-runtime-messaging-inbound-handler-evidence

source.content: global class CoreRuntimeMessagingInboundHandlerEvidenceHandler implements Messaging.InboundEmailHandler { global Messaging.InboundEmailResult handleInboundEmail(Messaging.InboundEmail email, Messaging.InboundEnvelope envelope) { Messaging.InboundEmailResult result = new Messaging.InboundEmailResult(); result.success = true; result.message = email.subject + ' from ' + envelope.fromAddress; return result; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingInboundHandlerEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.InboundEmail email = new Messaging.InboundEmail(); email.subject = 'Trail'; Messaging.InboundEnvelope envelope = new Messaging.InboundEnvelope(); envelope.fromAddress = 'sender@example.test'; envelope.toAddress = 'handler@example.test'; Messaging.InboundEnvelope clonedEnvelope = (Messaging.InboundEnvelope)envelope.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(envelope, clonedEnvelope); System.assertEquals('sender@example.test', clonedEnvelope.fromAddress); System.assertEquals('handler@example.test', clonedEnvelope.toAddress); Messaging.InboundEmailResult result = new CoreRuntimeMessagingInboundHandlerEvidenceHandler().handleInboundEmail(email, envelope); Messaging.InboundEmailResult clonedResult = (Messaging.InboundEmailResult)result.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(result, clonedResult); System.assertEquals(true, result.success); System.assertEquals('Trail from sender@example.test', result.message); System.assertEquals(true, clonedResult.success); System.assertEquals('Trail from sender@example.test', clonedResult.message); } }
